htf_slope_definition: Direction times the difference between the latest two completed higher-timeframe SMA60 values is strictly positive; HTF 5m->15m,15m->60m,60m->240m. Both values known at chart bar open.
four_r_definition: Add a resting gross4R limit to unchanged initial stop, close2R arm4ATR trail and next-open raw reversal; ambiguous OHLC stop and target uses stop first and is flagged.
notes: Each treatment changes one decision only; do not combine them.
Historical exploration, not untouched or forward validation.
No account leverage or capital assumptions; R uses actual next-open entry and frozen initial stop.
Binance data are not OKX performance; fixed archived tick sizes may differ from historical ticks.
Pivot-tie native parity remains a separate limitation of joint signals.
Add hints are not executed positions. No invented add-on profit.
No new Markdown/HTML report requested; retain reproducible code and machine-readable per-trade evidence.
